title: Gapped face complements have finite inner horn presentations
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices, inner horns and quasicategories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $n\geq2$ and let $J\subseteq[n]=\{0,\ldots,n\}$. For $S\subseteq[n]$, let $\Delta^S\subseteq\Delta^n$ be the face consisting of those simplices whose vertex image is contained in $S$. Put $K_J=\bigcup_{q\in J}\Delta^{[n]\setminus\{q\}}$; equivalently its simplices are the monotone maps into $[n]$ whose images do not contain all of $J$. Suppose that there are $i<j<k$ in $[n]$ with $i,k\in J$ and $j\notin J$. Then there is a finite filtration $K_J=L_0\subseteq L_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq L_t=\Delta^n$ by simplicial subsets such that every inclusion $L_{h-1}\hookrightarrow L_h$ is a pushout of an inner horn inclusion $\Lambda^{d_h}_{a_h}\hookrightarrow\Delta^{d_h}$ with $d_h\geq2$ and $0<a_h<d_h$. Pushout here means pushout in every simplicial degree in sets, with the induced simplicial operators. Consequently, for every quasicategory $Q$, every simplicial map $K_J\to Q$ extends to a simplicial map $\Delta^n\to Q$, with its restriction to $K_J$ exactly the given map.

from.place: Proof paragraph 2, finite-coefficient mapping-complex adjunction before R lim (supporting operadic-algebra presentability via the presentable Cartesian fibration theorem), through step 3 of lem-coef-small-right-adjoint-diagram-compact-model (the compact-object diagram F_0 and H = Ind^R F_0^op); GHN arXiv:1501.02161v3 proof of Theorem 10.3, final paragraph, and Definition 10.4. Supporting the representability of all lambda-compact Ind objects: HTT 5.5.7.8–5.5.7.10 use idempotent completeness, automatic for uncountable lambda because the walking idempotent is countable. In the supporting retract-closure argument: HTT Section 4.4.5, coherence of a weak retraction and its countable walking-idempotent colimit. HTT Definition 4.4.5.2, Remark 4.4.5.5 and Corollary 4.4.5.7, printed pp.304-305 (PDF pp.321-322); the homotopy-category retraction criterion is explained at the start of Section 4.4.5, printed p.303. Ret to Idem+ is inner anodyne by Proposition 4.4.5.6. Read online; no local archive or matching Stacks tag. More precisely, the finite simplicial horn lemma used in HTT Proposition 4.4.5.6 to extend the weak-retraction triangle (HTT Lemma 4.4.5.8).
